corrected_value.title: Development and Testing of a Self-report Instrument to Measure Actions: Outpatient Physical Therapy Improvement in Movement Assessment Log (OPTIMAL)

decisions.quote: BACKGROUND: The Outpatient Physical Therapy Improvement in Movement Assessment Log (OPTIMAL) is a recently developed self-report outcome instrument designed to measure the extent of activity limitation as defined by the World Health Organization. OBJECTIVE: The purposes of the study were to replicate some aspects of the original study of the OPTIMAL Difficulty and Confidence scales and to conduct additional psychometric tests.

Shipped row input_row_index 1114 (Guccione et al., 2005, Physical Therapy, DOI 10.1093/ptj/85.6.515, 'Development and Testing of a Self-report Instrument to Measure Actions: Outpatient Physical Therapy Improvement in Movement Assessment Log (OPTIMAL)', verified in Crossref metadata) is that exact original instrument development and psychometric testing study. Because the sole replicated target is already represented by shipped row 1114, no original study is missing.
